name: khposcommerce
description: KHPosCommerce - Unified Omnichannel POS & E-Commerce Ecosystem

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "API,MERCHANT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:merchant"
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n "API,MERCHANT,STORE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:merchant" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.build: npm run build:merchant && npm run build:storefront
scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:apps
scripts.setup:api: cd backend-khposcommerce && composer install && cp -n .env.example .env && php artisan key:generate
scripts.setup:apps: cd webclient/merchant-khposcommerce && npm install && cd ../storefront-khposcommerce && npm install
